newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast refined products gain in subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast refined products gain in subdued trade.

text.p: Refined product prices firmed Friday despite the fairly subdued trade in the region, market players said.
Bidders searched for buyers in the thin trading conditions, which helped push most gasolines up more than 1.00 cent on the day.
"I think the export situation is starting to take over some," one trader said, speculating the Canadian and Mexican offtake was tightening the market.
State-mandated prompt carb gasoline in Los Angeles was seen between 61.50 and 62.50 cents a gallon, while regular unleaded gasoline was seen at 58.00 to 59.00 cents.
On the NYMEX, August gasoline rallied 1.82 cents to finish at 64.00 cents a gallon and August heating oil firmed 0.60 cent to 53.90 cents a gallon.
